aiSettings.title: AI & Providers
aiSettings.subtitle: Control whether this workspace uses AI at all, and whose provider it uses.
aiSettings.loadFailed: Could not load AI settings for this workspace.
aiSettings.adminsOnly: Only the workspace owner or an admin can change these settings. You can see what is in force.
aiSettings.keyNeverRead: API keys cannot be read back — not here, not through the API, not by the person who saved them. Only a running AI call decrypts one. To change a key, paste a new one over it.

planGate.title: Available on Pro and Enterprise
planGate.body: This workspace is on the {tier} plan. Upgrade to turn AI off workspace-wide or to use your own provider keys. Any setting already saved stays in force.

inForce.label: In force now:
inForce.disabled: AI is switched off for this workspace.
inForce.workspace: Your own provider and key are serving this workspace.
inForce.platform: The platform's default provider is serving this workspace.

access.title: AI access
access.help: One switch for the whole workspace. It applies to every module, background job and scheduled task — not just the screens you can see.
access.disableLabel: Disable all AI for this workspace
access.disableHelp: Blocks every LLM call, including email classification, summaries, agents and file understanding.
access.reasonHelp: Recorded with the change, so the answer to "why is nothing working?" is here rather than in someone's memory.

provider.title: Your own provider
provider.help: Leave this on the platform default, or point the workspace at your own account so prompts travel on your contract.
provider.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted and never returned by the API.
provider.apiKeyRotateHelp: Leave blank to keep the installed key. Pasting a new one replaces it.
provider.keyRequired: This provider needs an API key.
provider.fallbackLabel: Fall back to the platform provider if mine fails
provider.fallbackHelp: Off by default: if you supplied a key so your prompts stay on your account, a silent fallback would defeat that.
